description: This file defines the OpenAiNativeHandler class, which manages interactions with the OpenAI Responses API, including streaming responses, handling various event types, and managing request options and error handling within a larger AI SDK.

classes.name: OpenAiNativeHandler
classes.description: A class that handles communication with OpenAI's Responses API, including streaming, request building, event processing, and error handling.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a message stream using the Responses API, formatting conversation history and handling streaming events.

methods.name: handleResponsesApiMessage
methods.description: Builds and sends a request to the Responses API, managing streaming and fallback error handling.

methods.name: buildRequestBody
methods.description: Constructs the request payload for the Responses API, ensuring schema compliance and including relevant options.

methods.name: executeRequest
methods.description: Performs the API request, manages abort signals, and processes the streaming response.

methods.name: formatFullConversation
methods.description: Formats conversation messages into the structure expected by the Responses API.

methods.name: makeResponsesApiRequest
methods.description: Performs a manual fetch request to the Responses API as a fallback when SDK streaming fails.

methods.name: handleStreamResponse
methods.description: Processes the SSE stream from the Responses API, parsing events and yielding structured output chunks.

methods.name: processEvent
methods.description: Shared handler for processing individual event objects from the Responses API stream.

methods.name: getReasoningEffort
methods.description: Determines the reasoning effort level based on options and model defaults.

methods.name: getPromptCacheRetention
methods.description: Returns cache retention policy based on model info.

methods.name: applyServiceTierPricing
methods.description: Overrides model pricing based on selected service tier.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Returns the current model configuration, including ID, info, and parameters.

methods.name: getEncryptedContent
methods.description: Extracts encrypted reasoning content for stateless API continuity.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Performs a non-streaming prompt completion via the Responses API.
